resources.name: The Embedded Rust Book
resources.desc: An introductory book about using the Rust Programming Language on "Bare Metal" embedded systems, such as Microcontrollers.

resources.name: The Rust on ESP Book
resources.desc: This book aims to provide a comprehensive guide on using the Rust programming language with Espressif SoCs and modules.

resources.name: Embedded Rust (no_std) on Espressif
resources.desc: Training for Rust using no_std (bare metal) approach on ESP32-C3, officially supported by Espressif.

resources.name: Embedded Rust (std) on Espressif
resources.desc: Training for Rust using std approach development on ESP32-C3 by Ferrous Systems. Uses the community-maintained esp-idf-hal ecosystem.

resources.name: Embedded Rust Workshop on the micro:bit v2
resources.desc: This book has a strong focus on teaching the practical application of embassy-rs on the micro:bit v2.

resources.name: Tweede golf's workshop
resources.desc: A full workshop about Rust and embedded Rust. The embedded parts use the nRF52840-DK and a LIS3DH breakout board. (github source)

resources.name: impl Rust on ESP32 Book
resources.desc: A hands-on guide that uses the ESP32 DevKit V1 to demonstrate how to work with various modules and sensors. (github source)

resources.name: Pico Pico Book
resources.desc: A hands-on guide that uses the Pico 2 (RP2350) to demonstrate how to work with various modules and sensors. (github source)

resources.name: Simplified Embedded Rust: Standard Library Edition
resources.desc: This book provides a quick path to start learning embedded Rust with minimal setup. Book is based on ESP devices and the Wokwi Simulator. This edition uses the standard library development approach which is based on the ESP-IDF framework.

resources.name: Simplified Embedded Rust: Core Library Edition
resources.desc: This book provides a quick path to start learning embedded Rust with minimal setup. Book is based on ESP devices and the Wokwi Simulator. This edition uses the core library development approach for bare metal development.

resources.name: Embedded Software with Rust
resources.desc: A practical introduction to building firmware that is fast, efficient, and far safer than traditional embedded software written in C or C++.

resources.name: probe-rs

resources.name: embedded-test
resources.desc: A versatile test harness for embedded devices, supporting unit tests, integration tests, async tests, and more.

resources.name: defmt
